title: Locations → Profile details at a glance

steps.caption: Location Info
steps.chapter: The profile as Google has it
steps.narration: Location Info is the profile as Google has it, read on the last sync.

steps.caption: Business name
steps.narration: The business name, as it appears on Google.

steps.caption: Description
steps.narration: The description, as it reads on the listing.

steps.caption: Service areas
steps.narration: Service areas list every town the listing serves.

steps.caption: Categories
steps.narration: The categories on the listing: Roofing contractor, then gutter cleaning and siding.

steps.caption: Services
steps.narration: Fourteen services on the listing. The Services tab lists every one of them.

steps.caption: Hours
steps.narration: Hours for every day of the week, as Google shows them.

steps.caption: Open status
steps.narration: And the open status. To change any of these, edit them in Google Business Profile.

steps.caption: Menu: Locations
steps.narration: The next sync brings the change here. You'll find Locations in the Google Business menu.

youtube.title: How to check your profile details as Google has them | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: The Location Info tab of a linked location in ConstructHUB: business name, description, address, service areas, phone, website, categories, services, hours, opening date and open status, exactly as Google has them on the last sync. You change them in Google Business Profile; the next sync brings the change over.
